author: SickProdigy
description: Connect each Discord server to an approved Navidrome library, browse recent albums, and announce new additions.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild connection selections, announcement settings, and announced album IDs. This initial version stores no member data. Navidrome credentials are read from Red shared API tokens.
install_msg: Configure credentials privately with `[p]set api navidrome_NAME username,YOUR_USER password,YOUR_PASSWORD`, approve the endpoint with `[p]navidromeowner connection add NAME URL`, then select it in a server with `[p]navidromeset connection NAME`.
name: Navidrome
short: Per-server Navidrome library connections and album announcements
